title: Realize the corrected P104 physical inverse-transpose
head: 7953c9a8f788a8de5cf2ced63d9a61b67c22c6f1
body:
PR2551 identifies an unpriced conversion from PR2497's backward logical charts to the ordinary physical inverse-transpose. This contribution supplies a complete finite canonical physical realization using conjugated complementary charts and 416 explicitly charged rank-one endpoint transports.

The word has 5398 events, 2070 positive transports and rank mass 3542 = 3126 + 416 H1. All 150 arbitrary dirty helper logical values restore, and all eight private collectors are exactly zero at erasure. The physical boundary is F_two^(-T) for the original canonical forward charts; PR2551's Y2=delta_0 witness gives X0[0]=(-1+i)/64, distinguishing it from the predecessor backward-chart zero.

The exact clean logical word is credited to ywz65/PR2497 (7f2cf129d42030d3eb3975b7d1b07392c6d32a1b), the boundary contract to PR2551 (249c4034da118da35f1e6009744b81461172bc61), and the complementary-frame idea to Nick Petalas/PR2550 (8af7c324714866afa199e4b7bf80a8f82e56d6f3). Full native/geometry/correction ancestry and source-specific credit are retained. No predecessor files are modified.

Validation on Python 3.12.14: sparse Fraction and separate dense scaled-integer execution agree on all 128164 boundary coefficients; 1245 native recipes cover all 2070 occurrences with exact phase; 8192 full private transport columns, 210 two-sided boundary transpose identities and 14400 root pairings pass. Seven semantic controls, six Git-free/export/source/typed-receipt groups, complete native regeneration, selected baseline bindings and whitespace checks pass. Separate AI peer review independently reconstructed the endpoint algebra and invoice, with no actionable finding; it did not rerun the full native verifier.

Reproduce:
```
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-physical-corrected-dual
python3 -I -B research/p104-physical-corrected-dual/verify.py --regenerate
```

The input X and output Y conversions decrease frames, so the full word is not covered by a monotone owner contract. Intrinsic endpoint adapters, rounded strict-zero erasure, physical owner/routing, idle/residual charges, a favorable complete recursive moment and all-size supplier admission remain open. The other 102 forward rows remain Gram/2. This is a finite native physical interface result, not an optimality theorem, complete supplier, full multiplication proof or new kappa.

Fresh canonical main remains 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority 4. Final overlap uses 779 open PRs at 15:23:17 UTC and 1239 Discussion records at 15:22:22 UTC on 2026-10-15, plus targeted fresh source-head/comment checks.
